purpose: Prompts for externally generating Manifest's trip cover-photo pool (destination images) — batch 2, covering cities added to the catalog after the v18 batch that still have no cover photo. Paste the "prompt" field for any entry directly into an image generation tool. Style, dimensions, and fallback images are shared with the original destination-photo-prompts.json — see that file for fallback_beach / fallback_city / fallback_default; they don't need to be regenerated.
style_guide: Professional travel photography, golden-hour lighting, dramatic warm sunset sky in soft pink, orange, and blue gradient tones, vibrant and slightly saturated color grading, wide-angle establishing shot, the landmark as a clear centered focal point with generous sky and environment around it, no people in the foreground, no text or watermarks, photorealistic, cinematic travel-magazine quality.

dimensions.composition_note: Keep the subject centered with margin above/below so the image still reads well if the app ever needs a tighter crop.
